AKA ASSASSINATION

By: Latashia Naidoo | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
The music industry is mourning the loss of one of SA's greatest rappers, who was the victim of a senseless killing in Durban last weekend.

Unique Selling Point:
AKA is one of the continent's most well-known and well-loved rappers. His death is one of a number in a series of murders of prominent Mzansi musicians, and shines a spotlight on the true cost of fame.

Summary:
Internationally-renowned rapper and hip-hop artist, Kiernan 'AKA' Forbes, was gunned down on Durban's Florida Road last night, in what's believed to have been a hit.
AKA was meant to perform at the popular Yugo Nightclub, when he was attacked outside the nearby Wish Restaurant by two armed men. His friend and former manager, Tebello Motosane, was also killed, while a bodyguard was severely wounded.

This story will look at the moments leading up to AKA's death, the rumours circulating, his star power and legacy. It will also explore the recent spate of attacks on other well-known musos in the industry, who have also been murdered.

Press Release:


Murder in Morningside
It’s late on a Friday night in Durban. A group of people emerge from a restaurant, among them arguably the country’s most famous musician. They’re in a jovial mood, hugging and shaking hands. Seconds later, a man rushes towards them, a gun in hand. He shoots before disappearing into the darkness. At the same time, another assailant fires at the group from a different direction. As chaos erupts, Kiernan Forbes, also known as AKA, and his friend, Tebello “Tibz” Motsoane, lie dead on the pavement. Their murder makes instant news on social media, and almost immediately speculation circulates on the motive for the killing. Could it be the work of KwaZulu-Natal’s notorious iinkabi – faceless guns for hire, apparently untouchable by law enforcement? As Forbes becomes the third musician gunned down in South Africa in the space of just four months, Carte Blanche investigates. 

Producer: Latashia Naidoo | Presenter: Bongani Bingwa

Script:


AKA ASSASSINATION: DRAFT SCRIPT

AKA: Hip hop music - this is what I do, it’s in my blood, it’s in my bones….

NEWS AUDIO:
“.... rapper Kiernan Forbes…. has been shot and killed in Durban…”

NEWS AUDIO: 00:08 -
“... Condolences are pouring in following the death of South African rapper Kiernan Forbes, also known as AKA…”


1 VO:
It’s just before 10 on a Friday night on Durban’s busy Florida Road…

(PAUSE)

2 VO:
A raucous dinner is coming to an end. Among the group of friends is rapper - Kiernan Forbes - better known as AKA.

(PAUSE)

3 VO:
Moments later… as the friends leave the restaurant… Forbes embraces one of them: it’s clear they’re close.

(PAUSE)

4 VO:
…while across the road, a lone figure… casually MAKES HIS WAY towards the group…

(PAUSE)

5 VO:
… for a moment, traffic obscures him… and he disappears from view for six seconds…

(PAUSE)

6 VO:
…then as AKA shares one last handshake… the man rushes up and at close range… points a gun to his head… and FIRES.

(PAUSE)

7 VO:
He dies… instantly.

(PAUSE)

8 VO:
Then a second gunman fires wildly in the same direction… wounding AKA’s bodyguard. And another of the friends is also hit….

[PAUSE]

9 VO:
The assailants disappear into the night…

(PAUSE)

UPSOUND: Wayne: “Well we actually received the case as an accident on Florida Road. On our arrival it was a whole different ballgame to the shooting. Two guys got shot.”

10 VO:
Wayne Kilian was a first responder on the scene.

UPSOUND:... “on arrival we got told that two got shot, one has already passed, and one is alive. So we rushed to the one who was still alive.”
UPSOUND RISHI: “...when we went inside, we saw basically a blood trail – we suspect that the person was shot there and started running. Due to the blood loss, he just felt weak and fell down.”

(PAUSE)

11 VO:
His partner Rishi Ramburan attended to the second victim…

UPSOUND RISHI: … “when we assessed the patient, the patient at that time was in shock.”

UPSOUND WAYNE: “LOC was dropping as we got to him, started treating, stopped breathing, did a rescuss, so ya, eventually we declared him on scene as passed.”
“His friend had a single gunshot to the left side of his chest.”

(PAUSE)

12 VO:
It was the friend AKA had warmly hugged moments earlier: his confidant, Tebello “Tibz” Motsoane…

(PAUSE)

UPSOUND Mom: 6:22 “... we had a plan that we are going to go out and have a meal together, because this year we hadn’t had a meal together. But he was in such a hurry, and he said: “No, I’ll come on another time, I’ll arrange with you – maybe next Sunday.”

13 VO:
... but next Sunday never came. Tebello’s elderly parents, Sylvester and Rayhab, last saw their only child a week before his brutal murder…

Bongani: How did you hear the news?
Sylvester: 03:30 – “We came together, held hands tight, and I told her: “Your son is no more.” She said: “What?! What are you saying?” “Your son, is no more.”

Bongani: “And how did you receive such news: “Your son is no more?”
Mrs Motsoane: “Actually I was numb, I felt numb, I couldn’t cry, feeling of disbelief. No it can’t happen to Tebello. That was the beginning of my misery.”

(PAUSE)

14 VO:

In the late 2000s, Tebello BECAME known as the ‘original hitmaker’... the man who ‘discovered’ AKA… forever changing the face of the local hip hop scene.

(PAUSE)

15 VO:

He would later transition from making music… to making food… becoming a celebrated chef…
And as their stars rose, Tibz and AKA remained close friends.

(PAUSE)

16 VO:
And yet, these old friends hadn’t planned to be at the same Florida Road restaurant.

Bongani: He hadn’t seen… AKA in a long time. He just was at the wrong place at the wrong time.
Dad: “We know that he’s been friends with AKA for ages. But that day I don’t think that he knew he was going to meet AKA.”

(PAUSE)

17 VO:

AKA was in town for a performance at a local club…
Tebello - to celebrate a friend’s 40th birthday. A fateful start to a night that would end in horror.

BONGANI LINK:
“It’s quiet now, but on any Friday night this place is buzzing with patrons. Wish is part of the hectic Durban night scene. The assailants shot their victims right here, and they ran across the street going past that mobile police station. And they disappeared into the night, nobody pursued them.”

Bongani: “Would you, based on your experience, say this was a hit?”
Wayne: “Yoh, Bongani, the fact that it happens so often in Durban, I presume it was a hit.”
Bongani: “You see these things all the time?”
Wayne: “Especially Durban, ya. Drive-by shootings, it happens a lot. And sometimes the public doesn’t know about it, or the media.”

18 VO:
The crime scene - now returning to normal - still bears the scars of the frenzied attack - marks on the walls where bullets must have ricocheted.

(PAUSE)

VO:
Certainly the hallmarks of a hit. And in KZN, fingers generally point to much-feared and faceless contract killers… called iinkabi.
UPSOUND SEAN: “Definitely it was a hit. And it was a professional hit.”

19 VO:
Sean Pierce is one of Durban’s leading private investigators.

UPSOUND SEAN: “The guys were in and out in seconds. Shots fired, bodyguards didn’t even have a chance to react. Commotion going, hitman gone. Well planned, well thought out, executed very well.”
BONGANI: “Are we seeing this all over the country, or specifically in KZN?”

SEAN: “The statistics for KZN hitmen are big. Because you can go to a hostel and get a hitman… Whether it’s a R5000 hit or a R500 000 hit, there’s still planning – and consequences to this.”
“It boils down to greed, corruption, turf wars, gang wars – but there’s just no accountability for it, it just keeps happening.”

20 VO:
But why would an entertainer… a rapper... be gunned down in cold blood?

21 VO:
Well, AKA isn’t the first…
Other musicians have suffered similar fates…

amaPiano producer, DJ Sumbody, was murdered in Woodmead, Johannesburg, in November last year…

22 VO:
Joy Mphande is an entertainment journalist.

UPSOUND JOY MPHANDE: “I think if you think back to Dj Sumbody’s killing… he was a club owner and it seems there was a trend of killings in Pretoria of club owners, that’s how people went to conclude about that, maybe there’s jealousy going on.
“But with AKA as we know him, he was just purely a musician…”

23 VO:
Then in January, another musician, Vusi Ma R5, was gunned down in Soshanguve, outside Pretoria.

The motives unclear, police say they are still following leads…

UPSOUND JOY: “A lot of artists and public figures in South Africa right now are very much alarmed by these recent incidents, more especially musicians since they are the ones that are being gunned down.”

[PAUSE]

24 VO:
A letter issued just this week by the National Prosecuting Authority has further muddied the waters, and given rise to unhelpful speculation into the motives for AKA’s murder.

25 VO:
It says the NPA had declined to prosecute anyone in relation to the mysterious April 2021 death of the rapper’s then-fiance, Anele Tembe.

(PAUSE)

26 VO: It’s long been speculated that the couple had argued that day, and the NPA’s letter has further fueled public debate about why AKA was killed.

At a media briefing this week though, his father called for an end to the speculation.

(PAUSE)

Meanwhile, Anele’s father, businessman Moses Tembe, issued a statement denying any involvement in AKA’s death, saying the accusations are “untrue” and “without substance”.

(PAUSE)

27 VO:
More than a week after the murders… in plain sight…
police have made no arrests… but say they’re following potential leads…

UPSOUND - “We have not arrested anyone yet. We have, however, interviewed a number of people - both in KZN as well as in Gauteng. Many people that we’ve obtained statements and collected cellphones. We are busy downloading some of those phones.”

(PAUSE)

28 VO:
Thousands of people attended memorial services for the slain men this week…

29 VO:
…. Taking no comfort in knowing that - as they mourned - the killers remain at large…

Bongani: I wish you strength, both of you. And thank you for talking to us.
Mom: Thank you.
______________________________________________________________________

PROMOS:
TEASER ONE:
VO:
Killed at gunpoint … rapper Kiernan Forbes and his close ally didn’t stand a chance against the armed hitmen…

UPSOUND
“It was a hit. And it was a professional hit. The guys were in and out in seconds.”

VO:
Now with several reported assassinations in the music industry, are South African artists under siege?

TEASER TWO:

VO:
Shot at close range... popular rapper Kiernan Forbes, didn’t stand a chance...

UPSOUND: “You can see the guy walks straight up, gun to his hit, pulls the trigger – it was definitely a hit, there’s no doubt about it. It was a hit!”

VO:
But why was one of South Africa’s biggest musical icons – AKA - brutally gunned down?

TEASER THREE:

VO:
Three music artists gunned down in just three months…

UPSOUND: “You can see the guy walks straight up, gun to his hit, pulls the trigger – it was definitely a hit, there’s no doubt about it. It was a hit!”

VO:
The murder of popular rapper AKA – the most recent in this long line of brutal killings…

UPSOUND: “Beef up your security, only way. You can’t hide yourself in your house now because you’re a famous person or you’re an artist, you still have to perform and that. Your point for A to B is your risk factor..”

VO:
So, is the music industry under siege?

At a media briefing this week though, his father called for an end to the speculation. (PAUSE) Meanwhile, Anele’s father, businessman Moses Tembe, issued a statement denying any involvement in AKA’s death, saying the accusations are “untrue” and “without substance”. (PAUSE) 27 VO: More than a week after the murders… in plain sight… police have made no arrests… but say they’re following potential leads… UPSOUND - “We have not arrested anyone yet. We have, however, interviewed a number of people - both in KZN as well as in Gauteng. Many people that we’ve obtained statements and collected cellphones. We are busy downloading some of those phones.” (PAUSE) 28 VO: Thousands of people attended memorial services for the slain men this week… 29 VO: …. Taking no comfort in knowing that - as they mourned - the killers remain at large… Bongani: I wish you strength, both of you. And thank you for talking to us. Mom: Thank you. ______________________________________________________________________ PROMOS: TEASER ONE: VO: Killed at gunpoint … rapper Kiernan Forbes and his close ally didn’t stand a chance against the armed hitmen… UPSOUND “It was a hit. And it was a professional hit. The guys were in and out in seconds.” VO: Now with several reported assassinations in the music industry, are South African artists under siege? TEASER TWO: VO: Shot at close range... popular rapper Kiernan Forbes, didn’t stand a chance... UPSOUND: “You can see the guy walks straight up, gun to his hit, pulls the trigger – it was definitely a hit, there’s no doubt about it. It was a hit!” VO: But why was one of South Africa’s biggest musical icons – AKA - brutally gunned down? TEASER THREE: VO: Three music artists gunned down in just three months… UPSOUND: “You can see the guy walks straight up, gun to his hit, pulls the trigger – it was definitely a hit, there’s no doubt about it. It was a hit!” VO: The murder of popular rapper AKA – the most recent in this long line of brutal killings… UPSOUND: “Beef up your security, only way. You can’t hide yourself in your house now because you’re a famous person or you’re an artist, you still have to perform and that. Your point for A to B is your risk factor..” VO: So, is the music industry under siege?

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): The music industry is mourning the loss of one of SA's greatest rappers, who was the victim of a senseless killing in Durban last weekend.
metadata.Unique Selling Point: AKA is one of the continent's most well-known and well-loved rappers. His death is one of a number in a series of murders of prominent Mzansi musicians, and shines a spotlight on the true cost of fame.
metadata.Summary: Internationally-renowned rapper and hip-hop artist, Kiernan 'AKA' Forbes, was gunned down on Durban's Florida Road last night, in what's believed to have been a hit. AKA was meant to perform at the popular Yugo Nightclub, when he was attacked outside the nearby Wish Restaurant by two armed men. His friend and former manager, Tebello Motosane, was also killed, while a bodyguard was severely wounded. This story will look at the moments leading up to AKA's death, the rumours circulating, his star power and legacy. It will also explore the recent spate of attacks on other well-known musos in the industry, who have also been murdered.
